title: montiopsis umbellata

This plant is known for its edible leaves and roots, which have been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Montiopsis umbellata include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
